Definition: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.
BiblicalUsage: Jambres is named once, beside Jannes, as one of the men who stood against Moses. In 2 Timothy 3:8 Paul says that as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these false teachers resist the truth, men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jambres is a warning I should not miss: a man can oppose God's servant with real power behind him and still be on the losing side.
